title: Search Shapes Conclusions: Auditing Evidence Selection Bias in Deep Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.39026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep Research agents synthesize evidence into cited reports, yet a well-cited report can still reach a misleading conclusion. Citation correctness checks whether cited sources support individual claims. It does not show whether adaptive search exposed a representative view of all documents made available for evaluation, which we call the candidate pool. Early findings redirect later queries, document choices, and stopping, so the documents an agent reads form a selective sample. Existing evaluations rarely account for this selection. We formulate the problem as adaptive evidence sampling and introduce Causal Evidence Selection Correction (CESS). CESS predicts each candidate document's evidence direction and corrects the candidate-pool average using the logged probabilities of selecting each document and reaching each search round. translated_title: 搜索塑造结论：审计深度研究智能体中的证据选择偏差
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体会将证据综合成带有引用的报告，然而一篇引用规范的报告仍可能得出具有误导性的结论。引用正确性检查的是被引文献是否支持具体的论断，但它并不能表明适应性搜索是否展现了对所有可供评估文档（我们称之为候选池）的代表性视图。早期的发现会引导后续的查询、文档选择和停止时机，因此智能体所阅读的文档构成了一个有偏的选择性样本，而现有评估很少考虑这种选择。我们将该问题形式化为适应性证据采样，并提出了因果证据选择校正方法。CESS预测每个候选文档的证据方向，并利用记录下来的选择每个文档及到达每一轮搜索的概率日志，对候选池平均值进行校正。收缩估计使短程搜索更加稳定，而当部分文档无法被采样时，则以区间估计替代点估计。
tldr: 该论文将深度研究智能体的证据选择偏差形式化为适应性证据采样问题，并提出因果证据选择校正（CESS）方法，利用日志选择概率校正候选池均值，从而审计智能体因搜索行为导致的结论失真。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes evidence selection bias in Deep Research agents as adaptive evidence sampling and introduces CESS (Causal Evidence Selection Correction), which uses logged selection probabilities to correct candidate-pool averages and audit whether search behavior distorts conclusions.
